runners_data.name: Al Maslool
runners_data.comment: One of the main contenders on penultimate effort; ready for a crack at this new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who made no impression at Yarmouth (kept to 1m) on turf debut most recently but may be ready for a crack at this longer distance; one of the main contenders on penultimate effort, namely 1l third at Lingfield (AW).

races.name: Racing To School Reaches 25 Years Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.spotlight: February foal; second foal; by Ubettabelieveit out of 6f winner (RPR 57), half-sister to several winners including Bahuta Acha (5f/6f including 2yo; RPR 84) and Mininggold (5f/6f including 2yo; 82); yard has low strike-rate in 2yo maiden and novice events in recent years; likely other days.

runners_data.name: Craven Force

runners_data.name: Beautiful Rainbow

runners_data.spotlight: April foal; 40,000euros yearling; first foal; by Cotai Glory out of 6f 2yo/1m winner (RPR 83) whose winning siblings include Amadeus Wolf (6f 2yo Group 1) and Rouleau (6f 2yo Group 3); bred to go a bit and yard 1-7 with 2yos here in last five years; market check needed.

runners_data.name: Half A Hoof

runners_data.name: Lauralynn

runners_data.spotlight: Suffered a wide passage on C&D debut (good to soft; 40-1) last week where she shaped quite nicely, losing second only late on behind a smart newcomer; should improve but there are dangers among the newcomers.

runners_data.name: Arrbob
runners_data.comment: Bred to be a good sprinter; very slowly away but some promise on debut; can improve

runners_data.name: Amantha
runners_data.comment: 28-1 for recent C&D debut when finishing at the back of the pack; unlikely this time
runners_data.spotlight: 28-1 for her recent debut over C&D when slowly away and finished at the back of the pack; unlikely for now; yard also runs Concert Pitch.

runners_data.name: Trilby
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with impressive C&D win, back on career-low mark but poor trainer form (0/16) concerning
runners_data.comment: Impressive C&D winner last April on sole course start; handily weighted and can go well
runners_data.spotlight: Three of five wins have come at Haydock but he found an impressive finish when winning over C&D (good) last April on sole course start; on his lowest mark since the summer of 2024 and can go well with tongue-tie refitted.

runners_data.name: Novello Lad
runners_data.note: Best at 6f on good ground, 199 days absent makes fitness debut a major question mark
runners_data.comment: All best form at 6f on good or quicker; lacks recent run and now has first-ever run at 5f
runners_data.spotlight: All best form at 6f on good or quicker ground; easily excused a modest farewell to 2025 on account of soft going but he does have something to prove in his first-ever 5f run.

runners_data.name: Jenever
runners_data.note: Handles stiff 5f tracks well, back on winning mark but poor recent course form away from Sandown
runners_data.comment: Unraced here but this stiff 5f can suit and he's back on same mark as latest Sandown win
runners_data.spotlight: Unraced on this course but some of his best form has come over Sandown's similarly stiff 5f and he's back on the same mark as his latest win there last June (good; a race he'd won 12 months earlier); every chance of being seen to good effect back on turf.

runners_data.name: Arctic Summer
runners_data.note: Struggled with high marks last year, recent form modest and lacks course experience
runners_data.comment: Won over 6f in France as 2yo; high in weights since; may need more weight off her back
runners_data.spotlight: Won over 6f in France (very soft) as 2yo; couldn't cope with high marks in Britain last year and made no serious impact on reappearance at Doncaster (6f, good to soft) last month; may need more weight off her back.

runners_data.name: Fuji Mountain
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form, 9lb claimer Wheatley adds value but low weight suggests limited ability

runners_data.name: I'm Next
runners_data.note: Consistent handicapper who lost lead late last time, good recent form but yet to win a turf handicap
runners_data.comment: 3-11 in handicaps; decent reappearance 2nd over C&D last week; due 1lb rise
runners_data.spotlight: Has won three of 11 handicaps (heavy/AW/good to soft; acts on good to firm), also runner-up to strong candidates on two occasions, including when losing his lead near the line over C&D last week; solid chance off the same mark; due 1lb rise.

runners_data.name: Tees Aggregates
runners_data.note: Course winner who can be slowly away, unlucky last time but long winter break raises fitness doubts
runners_data.comment: Powerful front-running win over C&D in August; unlucky in running on recent AW return
runners_data.spotlight: Can be slowly away but he showed no mercy to his rivals when making all over C&D (good to firm) last August; returned from a long winter break with an unlucky run on Southwell AW 16 days ago and he's one to be interested in back on this track; yard won race in 2022.

runners_data.name: Until Dawn
runners_data.note: Only pace angle but wind surgery and 153 days off make her reliability highly questionable
runners_data.comment: Two AW wins at 5f in early 2025; below par in the autumn; first turf run for nearly a year
runners_data.spotlight: Two 5f wins on the AW early in 2025 but she was well below her best on sand in the autumn; has had wind surgery since but the suitability of this track is in doubt now back on turf for the first time in nearly a year.

races.paceDynamic: Until Dawn is the only confirmed front-runner, but with her questionable form and fitness after wind surgery, she may not sustain a genuine gallop throughout. Fuji Mountain and I'm Next will likely sit handy, but neither is aggressive enough to ensure a truly searching pace from the outset. This sets up a moderate tempo that will quicken late as the field bunches for home. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late finishing kicks, particularly those with proven course form like Ventura Express and tactical speed like Trilby.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Until Dawn sets a manageable tempo without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows the talented hold-up horses to conserve energy and unleash decisive late runs. Ventura Express's course form and Trilby's finishing kick become decisive advantages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Suits Speed
scenarios.trigger: If Until Dawn falters early leaving no genuine pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from halfway with prominent runners gaining crucial position advantage. I'm Next and Fuji Mountain can capitalize on their handy positions while closers struggle to make ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Tests Stamina
scenarios.trigger: If I'm Next or Fuji Mountain join Until Dawn to create genuine pace
scenarios.body: The honest tempo stretches the field and rewards horses with proven staying power over the trip. Tees Aggregates benefits from his front-running ability while course specialist Ventura Express stays on strongest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses dispute the lead creating tactical chaos
scenarios.body: The disjointed pace suits versatile performers who can adapt to circumstances. Jenever's tactical flexibility and Arctic Summer's French breeding help them navigate the confusion.

watchPoints.text: Until Dawn's fitness after wind surgery and long absence - if she folds early the race loses all pace
Novello Lad returning after 199 days - his class could be decisive if fitness holds up
Trilby's position turning for home - needs room to deliver his trademark late kick
Tees Aggregates jumping from the stalls - his slow starts could be costly in a small field
I'm Next and Fuji Mountain disputing second position - either could benefit if Until Dawn weakens

runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo whose last two efforts, latest on stable/seasonal debut, can be excused; steadily progressive RPRs otherwise and gained sole success over C&D (good to firm); interesting back down in class and returned to this scenario.

runners_data.spotlight: Has failed to show his form in last four appearances but ground softer than good wasn't ideal on seasonal debut latest; 2lb below last winning mark and holds a fighting chance provided he rebounds.

runners_data.name: Highfield Viking
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner drawn on the rail with a good April record but 170 days off the track

runners_data.name: Surprised

runners_data.name: Milteye
runners_data.note: Likely leader with tactical versatility and recent course form but may do too much early work
runners_data.comment: Escapes penalty for Ripon win last week; drawn wide but otherwise holds strong claims
runners_data.spotlight: Campaigned mostly on good ground or softer; tactically versatile; overcame traffic issues to get up in the final strides in apprentice race at Ripon (1m) last week, taking turf record to 5-20; drawn wide but otherwise has strong claims with penalty avoided; future mark 3lb higher.

runners_data.name: Nyman
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with turf win last backend but returning from all-weather campaign
runners_data.comment: Won at Newmarket in most recent turf attempt; possibilities back in this sphere
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish 4yo whose form (three attempts) for new yard features a win at Newmarket (7f, good to soft) last backend; possibilities returned to turf with AW reappearance (midfield) under his belt.

runners_data.name: Yaajooz
runners_data.note: Prominent style with claiming jockey allowance but poor record for current stable despite placings
runners_data.comment: Form for current yard features a few second-place finishes that represent peak form

runners_data.name: Priapos
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent all-weather form needs to translate back to turf

runners_data.name: Tropez Power
runners_data.note: Prominent runner carrying bottom weight after 173-day absence but inconsistent recent form

runners_data.name: Frostmagic
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who made all at Southwell but stepping back up in trip may not suit
runners_data.comment: Made all at Southwell when last seen; could make another bold bid; stable 3-5 this month
runners_data.spotlight: Has won over middle distances, including on turf, but seems to need shorter nowadays and made all over 1m at Southwell (AW) when last seen; could make a bold bid on this track provided he again goes from the front; stable going very well (3-5 with big LSP) this month; respected.

races.paceDynamic: Milteye will likely lead from the off with his prominent style and recent form, setting a sustainable pace without serious early pressure. Lord Roxby, A War Eagle, Nyman, Yaajooz, Tropez Power and Frostmagic will track the leader in a bunched group, creating a moderate gallop over the first 5f. The race will develop into a sprint finish from 2f out as the hold-up horses Capital Guarantee, Highfield Viking, Surprised and Priapos come with their challenges. This setup strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick, as they'll get first run on the leaders while avoiding traffic issues that could trap the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace allows prominent runners to travel comfortably behind Milteye
scenarios.body: The pace-tracking horses get first run at the leader from 2f out while hold-up horses struggle for room in the straight. A War Eagle, Nyman or Yaajooz can kick clear with Milteye having done too much donkey work.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate gallop becomes a crawl and the field bunches up entering the straight
scenarios.body: The slow pace negates the prominent runners' positional advantage and allows the closers to unleash devastating finishes. Capital Guarantee or Priapos can weave through traffic to collar the leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wire-to-Wire Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Milteye gets an uncontested lead and the others fail to organize a sustained challenge
scenarios.body: The leader maintains his advantage throughout as the chasers cancel each other out with their moves coming too late. Milteye holds on grimly as the closers run out of room to reel him in.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from 3f out
scenarios.body: The extreme change of tempo catches the fancied runners cold and allows an outsider with fresh legs to strike. Tropez Power's low weight or Surprised's class can exploit the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Milteye could steal this if allowed an uncontested lead as the others may leave their challenges too late
Capital Guarantee needs watching for market support as his recent poor form may not reflect true ability
A War Eagle's last two runs can be excused and his course and distance win gives him a strong chance if back to form
The 5lb and 7lb claiming riders on Capital Guarantee and Yaajooz could make crucial errors in a tactical finish
Highfield Viking's excellent April record makes him dangerous despite the long layoff if the pace sets up right

runners_data.name: Freddy Robinson

runners_data.spotlight: Gained most recent win in handicap hurdle in December; beaten only 2l over C&D last week, taking Beverley record to 1423234; hasn't scored on Flat since June 2024 but looks a solid contender kept to this venue.

runners_data.name: Iwantmytimewithyou

runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who completed a turf double (1m4f/1m6f) last July; creditable second at Kempton (1m4f, AW) on reappearance; has shown all that best form in Class 6 but may do better still this term; respected.

races.paceDynamic: Roland Garros will lead from the gate with no other confirmed pace-setters in this seven-runner field. The early leader should get an uncontested advantage through moderate fractions, with Freddy Robinson likely tracking in second from his prominent style. The rest - Kitsune Power, Valley Of Flowers, Naval Tribute, Dr Rio and Iwantmytimewithyou - will all be held up behind the pace. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can capitalize on the soft pace and time their challenges late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Roland Garros sets pedestrian fractions and fades in the straight
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader tires after dictating terms, allowing the five hold-up runners to sweep past with late runs. The tactical advantage shifts decisively to those who conserved energy behind the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner steals it
scenarios.trigger: If Roland Garros capitalizes on the soft pace and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The leader exploits his tactical position by quickening when the field is still getting organized, building an unassailable advantage. His Catterick win suggests he can sustain his effort when unopposed early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Freddy Robinson positions perfectly in second and outkicks the field
scenarios.body: The Brian Ellison runner uses his prominent style to shadow Roland Garros then pounces when the leader weakens. His recent close second over course and distance demonstrates he knows this track well.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Roland Garros goes too slow and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The pedestrian early pace turns the 1m4f contest into a dash from the 3f pole with all seven still in contention. This creates a lottery where any horse can win regardless of rating.

watchPoints.text: Roland Garros could steal this if he gets away with soft fractions and the hold-up horses leave it too late
Kitsune Power's market support given his ideal hold-up style and encouraging Catterick return
Dr Rio's price given his exceptional Beverley record and suitability for the likely pace scenario
Freddy Robinson's positioning behind Roland Garros - if he tracks the leader perfectly he could strike
Valley Of Flowers returning from 216-day break but hold-up style suits if she's retained her ability

races.paceDynamic: Drumcondra stands alone as the confirmed front runner in this small field, giving him control to set a sustainable tempo without early pressure. The prominent racers No Knee Never, Copper And Five, and Man Is King will track close behind but none are aggressive pace-pressers. With multiple hold-up horses including Maple, Moonlight Bomb, Tees George, Woodleigh and Habari requiring a strong gallop to be effective, the lack of pace pressure favors those who can position handy and avoid getting caught in a slowly-run affair. This tactical setup strongly favors prominent racers and those with tactical pace who can avoid being trapped behind a moderate tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Drumcondra Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Drumcondra gets uncontested control and maintains a steady but not taxing pace throughout
scenarios.body: The front runner can dictate terms without pressure and kick clear in the straight, while prominent trackers get first run. Hold-up horses struggle to make ground from off the moderate pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Applied
scenarios.trigger: If No Knee Never or Copper And Five press Drumcondra earlier than expected to ensure a true gallop
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up perfectly for closers who can finish strongly from off the pace. Drumcondra may crack under unexpected pressure having been used to easier leads.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate but one prominently-placed horse produces a decisive move at the two-furlong pole
scenarios.body: A horse positioned in the first four can quicken past the front runner before the hold-up brigade gets organized. The winner combines tactical positioning with a sharp turn of foot.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong throughout allowing hold-up horses optimal conditions to close
scenarios.body: Despite the likely moderate tempo, if genuine pace materializes it transforms the race dynamics completely. The best closer with proven stamina can reel in tired leaders.

watchPoints.text: Drumcondra gets an uncontested lead and the pace becomes crawling through the middle stages, neutralizing all hold-up horses
No Knee Never's 5lb penalty combined with his prominent style could see him pressed too hard early if others decide to challenge for the lead
The betting market for Habari given his 255-day absence and poor recent form - any support suggests connections expect improvement
Moonlight Bomb and other hold-up horses getting trapped behind the moderate tempo with nowhere to go in the straight
Any late market moves for Woodleigh or Maple suggesting their respective stables expect better than recent form indicates

races.paceDynamic: Hashtagnotions is the sole confirmed front runner in this field and will set a sustainable tempo without pressure from pace rivals. The 8 hold-up horses will form a compact pack behind, with Hostelry, Coolree, and Sunny Orange likely tracking closest as the most experienced campaigners. This will create a slowly-run race over 1m2½f that builds to a sprint finish from the 2f pole. The lack of pace pressure clearly favors front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without expending energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Hashtagnotions gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of pace opposition allows him to control fractions and time his effort perfectly, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back. His sole C&D win came in soft ground but he's been consistent recently and gets ideal tactical conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and sets up a blanket finish
scenarios.body: The experienced hold-up horses get their preferred scenario where stamina and tactical speed matter most over raw pace positioning. Hostelry's C&D win and Sunny Orange's course record become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improving Handicapper Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Mini Mac or Glitter Code show significant improvement for new connections
scenarios.body: The reduced trip suits Glitter Code dropping back from 2m, while the tactical setup allows patient rides to be effective. Both horses have shown ability but need to find several pounds improvement.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If Bizarre Law's recent Nottingham third signals a return to form on turf
scenarios.body: His low weight becomes telling in a slowly-run race where the finish is bunched, and his recent placed effort suggests renewed vigor. The tactical scenario allows him to stay closer to the pace than usual.

watchPoints.text: Hashtagnotions must be watched for market confidence as the sole pace angle gives him a significant tactical advantage

Watch for support for Glitter Code who drops markedly in trip and represents in-form Edward Bethell stable
Keep an eye on Bizarre Law's price movement following his encouraging Nottingham third return to turf
Check if Sunny Orange shows early alertness as his course record is strong despite recent modest form

races.paceDynamic: Barbury Boy appears the only confirmed front-runner in this field, likely to get an uncontested lead with most runners preferring hold-up tactics. With limited early pace pressure, the race will develop into a tactical affair where Barbury Boy can dictate terms through moderate fractions before the large pack of hold-up horses converge in the final three furlongs. The lack of pace pressure early creates a sprint finish scenario where horses with tactical speed and those that can quicken off the bridle will have distinct advantages. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit just off the pace and hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Barbury Boy gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the leader to save energy for a sustained drive, while the hold-up brigade gets bunched and struggles to reel in the advantage. Prominent runners tracking the leader are perfectly positioned to strike if the front-runner falters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace sets up a cavalry charge finish
scenarios.body: The bunched field creates traffic problems and favours horses with the best turn of foot who can find gaps late. Hold-up specialists with proven class edge and tactical speed benefit most from the sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Jambearee or Duchess T sit perfectly positioned behind the leader
scenarios.body: The prominent runners avoid the late traffic while staying within striking distance of Barbury Boy's steady gallop. They can time their challenge to perfection and have enough left to repel late closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and becomes a sprint from the three-furlong pole
scenarios.body: The tactical nature completely suits a horse whose best efforts have come in slowly-run races or who has been underestimated by the market. Class and finishing kick become the decisive factors.

watchPoints.text: Barbury Boy getting an easy lead through slow fractions could prove decisive given the lack of pace pressure
Von Dutch and Alice De Clare both switching to turf for first time after AW efforts - market support would be significant
Jambearee's ability to sustain his effort beyond two furlongs out given his tendency to fade in the closing stages
Duchess T and Barbury Boy both returning after 140+ day breaks in a race requiring peak fitness for the finish
Dream Of Ithaca and Lynxman both making debuts for new connections and needing marked improvement to feature
